The diagnostic performance of multiparameter MRI parameters in different zones is not consistent with the Gleason score and tumor cellularity of prostate cancer.

the diagnostic performance of multiparameter MRI (mpMRI) is superior to conventional MRI in predicting the Gleason score (GS) of prostate cancer (PCa) and the presence of high-grade cancer in the peripheral zone (PZ) of the prostate, but the diagnostic performance of mpMRI is not superior to conventional MRI for predicting GS and the presence of cancer in the transition zone (TZ).
